name: -10 AN 180 Degree Female Aluminum Hose End (PTFE)
title: -10 AN 180 Degree Female Aluminum Hose End (PTFE)
description:
The -10 AN 180 Degree Female Aluminum Hose End (PTFE) is a premium high-performance component engineered for rigorous fluid and boost applications. ColorFittings 180 Degree PTFE Female Aluminum Hose Ends are precision-engineered for high-pressure fuel, oil, coolant, brake, clutch, power steering, and E85 applications. Designed specifically for PTFE (Teflon-lined) braided hose, these PTFE fittings provide a secure, leak-free 37-degree flare seal for demanding street performance, racing, marine, and motorsport plumbing systems.

Each PTFE female hose end is CNC machined from aerospace-grade 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings’ proprietary polishing and anodizing process for superior corrosion resistance, strength, and long-term durability. Built to handle high temperature and high-pressure environments, these fittings are fully compatible with E85, ethanol, race fuel, pump gas, brake fluid, transmission fluid, oil, coolant, and hydraulic systems.

Technical Specifications:
• Construction: Precision CNC-machined in the USA. (6061-T6 Billet Aluminum for fittings)
• Flow Configuration: 180° mandrel-bent profile for maximum velocity.
• Compatibility: Engineered for PTFE hose. Impervious to E85, race gas, methanol, and power steering fluid.
